nodes.name: Generate recipes (AI Agent)
nodes.notes: At most two Gemini calls (maxIterations 2) via the AI Agent; output shape enforced by the Structured Output Parser. Errors continue on the error output and become an ai_failed envelope in the map node.

nodes.name: Receive recipe request
nodes.notes: POST /webhook/generate-recipe. allowedOrigins answers the CORS preflight for the two dev origins and the deployed frontend.

nodes.name: Validate & rate limit
nodes.notes: Server-side validation (independent of the frontend) and the daily cost cap: 3 recipes/IP, 12 system-wide. Reserves a slot before the LLM call.

nodes.name: Passed the guard?
nodes.notes: route=ok continues to the model; route=error goes straight to the error response.

nodes.name: Map AI answer to recipes
nodes.notes: Sanitises the model output into GeneratedRecipe[]; unusable output becomes an ai_failed envelope.

nodes.name: Recipes usable?
nodes.notes: route=ok returns the recipes; route=error returns the ai_failed envelope.

nodes.name: Respond: recipes
nodes.notes: Success envelope (status ok, three recipes) with CORS header.

nodes.name: Respond: error
nodes.notes: Error envelope from the JSON contract. HTTP 200 on purpose: the frontend reads the envelope from any status.
